span_policy: first contiguous 128 baseline-encoded input IDs including tokenizer-added special tokens, no retokenization
bottom_count_policy: floor(eligible_positions * 0.2); zero is invalid, never assigned score zero
formula: author-context-standardized log-ratio; paper Eqs 9-11; per-original/per-altered prefix moments
boundary_policy: pinned author code: t in 1..N-1; future j in t+1..min(t+5,N-2), inclusive; N<3 invalid
eligibility: predictable code targets, non-special, nonempty offset; all original context IDs retained
padding_policy: right padding with attention mask; no tokens added to tokenizer; real position IDs start at zero
